title: Psychology Facts
hook: Three quiet reasons you like what you like.
facts: One: Zajonc found that *repeated exposure* makes faces and symbols feel nicer.
Two: the *IKEA effect*. You value things more when you built them yourself.
Three: the *endowment effect*. In Kahneman's mug study, owners wanted *double* the price.
outro: Familiar. Yours. Self-made. Notice them today.
